The successful candidate will communicate with customers through approved channels, including email, live chat, phone, and online customer support platforms. Retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing activities. CRM or customer support platforms. Ticket-management systems. Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. Customer account or order processing. Data entry and record maintenance. Remote communication and collaboration tools. Experience gained through internships, volunteer work, academic projects, freelance assignments, or other customer-facing activities may also be considered. Skills & Competencies Successful Candidates Should Demonstrate Customer-focused communication. Active listening and patience. Problem-solving and conflict resolution. Professional written and verbal communication. Strong attention to detail. Accurate data entry and documentation. Customer account management. Time management and multitasking. Adaptability and willingness to learn. Dependability and professionalism. Confidential information handling. Ability to work independently and collaboratively. 85c1860c0348ffc9.description: Job description Position Summary Location: Riyadh Audit & Assurance | Senior Manager About Deloitte : When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award. Our Purpose Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities. Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact: Lead the way Serve with integrity Take care of each other Foster inclusion Collaborate for measurable impact Audit & Assurance | Senior Manager During your tenure as a Senior Manager in Audit & Assurance, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas: Identifies the entity's strategic audit and risk priorities and highlights these to key stakeholders, proactively offering strategic insights to address these Makes sure that risk assessment procedures were appropriately considered in the development of the plan, execution of audit procedures, and evaluation of audit results Contributes knowledge and perspective to the risks, materiality and scope discussions for the audit report and checks the audit plan covers all the relevant areas with consideration of wider business issues. Considers messaging from National Audit Office, trends in audit reporting and peer reporting via National Audit Office tools and publications Includes the expert/specialist in audit planning meetings to discuss planned involvement of the expert/specialist and sets expectations regarding the application of an appropriate level of professional skepticism by the expert/specialist Actively participates in the group risk assessment and planning of work to be performed by component auditors. Review’s referral instructions on a timely basis and evaluates responses from component auditors. Resolves issues identified, including where work has been referred to challenging environments Is familiar with analysis on audit reports, uses the Guide to audit reporting, has read several other audit reports in the same industry before drafting a new report Drives the audit team in a robust approach to revenue testing by: utilizing process flow diagrams for material revenue streams, gaining a deep understanding of the entity's recognition policies and how they relate to terms and conditions, actively considering the appropriateness of a controls reliance approach, and developing a tailored approach to address the risk of fraud Develops and reviews comprehensive project plans for complex engagements early in the audit cycle, that include clear timescales, co-ordination with the extended engagement team, has a clear contingency plan to mitigate the risks of unseen obstructions, and has adequate resources with the required skills and knowledge for testing Communicates the project plan and any entity related dependencies (e.g., documentation, reviews) with the entity's management team so that they are aware, at the beginning of the audit, of any repercussions (e.g., deadlines, fees) due to deviations from this plan. When slippages arise, clearly ascertains how they arose and negotiates overruns with the entity's management team where appropriate Facilitates application of professional skepticism by driving early consultation with relevant facts in areas where consultation is either mandatory or necessary for the relevant experience, objectivity and knowledge to be applied in forming a judgement Engages with the firm's quality control procedures and commits to audit quality by driving improvement of prior year testing and consistently challenging whether the global audit imperatives have been reflected in the planning and execution of the audit Leadership Capabilities: Builds own understanding of our purpose and values; explores opportunities for impact Demonstrates strong commitment to personal learning and development; acts as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent Understands expectations and demonstrates personal accountability for keeping performance on track Actively focuses on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills Understands how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business. Demonstrates ability to apply AI in an audit context to improve efficiency and quality (e.g., relevant use cases), including prompt engineering fundamentals and structured problem-solving. Exercises professional scepticism when using AI-generated outputs—validates accuracy, completeness, and appropriateness before use in audit documentation/workpapers. Understands responsible AI expectations in professional services, including governance/risk considerations, confidentiality and data integrity, and use of firm-approved AI tools (including Deloitte-specific tools where applicable). Qualifications: MBA or equivalent, preferably a degree in Accounting, Auditing, or any related field Minimum 10 years of experience in public accounting, auditing, audit management, budget, business plan, business strategy, preferably with big Firms. Extensive knowledge of best practice reporting and International financial reporting standards. Able to ensure that the applicable accounting and auditing standards have been consistently applied and obtains appropriate evidence to support the assessment that the financial statements have been prepared in in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework Ability to develop one's own knowledge and the knowledge of others as it relates to Deloitte's tools and audit methodology and the applicable professional accounting and auditing standards through both formal learning and on-the-job training Ability to thoroughly review audit documentation for completeness, accuracy and adequacy while ensuring timely archiving of work papers International accounting qualification is required: CA, ACCA, or CPA. Fluent in English (reading, speaking, and writing). Preference will be given to Bilingual candidates (Arabic/English) For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below. Preferred candidate Years of experience 5+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

8541a03d8a14f48d.description: We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help design, scale, and secure our rapidly growing platform infrastructure. You will work across all critical systems — from customer-facing applications and APIs to internal platforms and data services — ensuring availability, performance, and cost efficiency at scale. You’ll be hands-on with Kubernetes, observability, GitOps, automation, and cloud infrastructure, while partnering closely with application, platform, and data teams to deliver a highly reliable and self-healing environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives on complex distributed systems, loves to automate everything, and can balance speed, stability, and cost-efficiency in production. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent work experience . Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain production workloads across Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) clusters. Build self-healing, auto-scaling systems that minimize manual intervention and ensure uptime. Design and operate reliable database and storage platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and object stores) within Kubernetes environments. Implement backup, disaster recovery, replication, and failover strategies to meet RPO/RTO targets. Troubleshoot and recover Kubernetes Persistent Volumes (StorageClasses, CSI drivers, PVC issues) . Optimize storage performance and cost through multi-tier strategies, hot/cold data separation , and S3/offloading lifecycle policies . Secure and scale object storage platforms (e.g., MinIO/S3-compatible) for high-throughput data pipelines . Manage block storage (EBS/io2/gp3) and shared file systems (EFS, NFS) for resilience and cost balance. Collaborate with teams to optimize networking, ingress/egress traffic , and service mesh for secure communication. Platform & Infrastructure Reliability Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain production workloads across Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) clusters. Build self-healing, auto-scaling systems that minimize toil and manual intervention. Optimize networking, ingress/egress traffic control, and service mesh for secure & performant communication. Design and operate reliable database and storage platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and object stores) in Kubernetes environments. Own backup, disaster recovery, replication, and failover strategies to meet RPO/RTO targets for critical data services. Optimize storage performance and cost through multi-tier strategies, hot/cold data separation, and S3/offloading lifecycle policies. Troubleshoot and recover Kubernetes Persistent Volumes confidently during incidents (StorageClasses, CSI drivers, PVC issues). Secure and scale object storage platforms (e.g., MinIO/S3-compatible) and integrate with workloads for high-throughput data pipelines. Work with block storage (EBS/io2/gp3) and shared file systems (EFS, NFS) to balance performance, resiliency, and cost. Automation & Delivery Champion GitOps and CI/CD best practices (ArgoCD, Flux, GitHub Actions). Build automation for infrastructure provisioning and upgrades using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes Operators. Reduce release risk through progressive delivery strategies (blue/green, canary, spot instance rolling updates). Observability & Incident Response Own the monitoring and alerting stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, VictoriaMetrics, OpenSearch). Lead incident management and postmortems to prevent recurrence. Provide real-time visibility into system health, performance, and cost metrics. Security & Compliance Implement least-privilege IAM policies, secure service-to-service communication, and network ACLs/firewalls. Enforce Kubernetes RBAC, secret management, and secure image supply chain. Participate in audit readiness and compliance efforts. Performance & Cost Optimization Analyze and tune system performance under scale (CPU/memory/IO). Partner with product and platform teams to right-size clusters, databases, and storage tiers. Introduce cost visibility dashboards for engineering leadership. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing mission-critical systems at scale (high traffic, multi-region). Proven cost optimization in cloud/K8s environments. Familiarity with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) or advanced networking/egress control. Experience with data platform components (Airflow, Debezium, ClickHouse, etc.) is a plus but not required. Strong communication skills and teamworker — able to collaborate across engineering, DevOps, security, and product teams. 8+ years in SRE / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles. Deep Kubernetes expertise (multi-cluster, Helm chart development, advanced networking). Strong GitOps workflows using ArgoCD/Flux. Expertise with AWS (preferred) or Azure/GCP, plus Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation). Advanced knowledge of SQL & NoSQL databases (MySQL/Aurora, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis). Scripting/automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go. Solid background in monitoring/observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/Opensearch, VictoriaMetrics). Experience with CI/CD at scale and managing production incidents. Experience with streaming/messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar). Comprehensive Training & Development programs. 85595673abe9053b.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems operates as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia under Government-to-Government arrangements. Role Overview: Engineering Manager Industrialisation Typhoon Programmes This full-time role, based in Riyadh, focuses on leading the technical aspects of contracting and integrating Original Equipment Manufacturers' capabilities into Saudi Industry for the Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) of aircraft components. The Engineering Manager will ensure appropriate levels of engineering and maintenance governance and assurance are applied throughout these processes. The role also involves supporting the expansion and improvement of existing in-Kingdom industrialised Avionic and General Systems maintenance and repair capabilities, and developing innovative technical solutions for new capabilities within future Salam Service Solutions. This position requires 5-10 years of experience and demands effective communication, internal/external stakeholder management, and a high degree of flexibility to meet demanding delivery schedules in a fast-paced contracting environment. Collaborative working with BAE Systems Air UK in a "One Team" environment is a fundamental responsibility. Key Responsibilities Complete engineering management and planning for all Typhoon Capability Insertion and In-Kingdom maintenance programmes, ensuring technical deliverables meet Customer and Project milestones. Ensure consistent compliance with BAE Systems maintenance governance and the application of full Lifecycle Management across all Typhoon In-Kingdom programmes. Develop and maintain robust Requirements Management, Configuration Management, and Change Control processes for all Typhoon Capability Insertion and In-Kingdom programmes, in compliance with BAESSA and Salam engineering policies. Provide Technical Subject Matter Expertise (SME) for all In-Kingdom Industrialisation Programme (IKIP) related maintenance issues on the Typhoon Programme, including guidance and support to Saudi Industry. Manage the engineering validation of candidates submitted for Capability Insertion as part of the Salam Service Solution Support functional engineering capability development of team members, including tools & process improvements, continuous development & training. Demonstrated ability to lead technical aspects of contracting and capability insertion. Strong understanding of engineering and maintenance governance and assurance principles. Proficiency in Requirements Management, Configuration Management, and Change Control processes. Proven technical Subject Matter Expertise, particularly in maintenance issues related to complex aircraft programmes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both internal and external. Ability to rapidly innovate technical solutions without compromising compliance or performance. Flexibility to operate within a high-paced contracting environment and meet demanding delivery schedules. Employee Benefits For expatriate employees, a competitive salary, rent-free accommodation, and access to free recreation facilities within Company-secured accommodation are provided. A generous leave and travel allowance is also included. Initial appointment to Saudi Arabia will be on single status, with the opportunity to apply for family relocation in the future. A full health care scheme is provided within Saudi Arabia. Saudi National employees will receive a competitive salary and benefits package, including a generous leave and travel allowance, a full health care scheme, and access to subsidised recreational facilities.

85d0cf74a269a05e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قناص العربية عن طاهٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى الطاهي مسؤولية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وطهيها، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على نظافة المطبخ والأدوات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيز وتحضير وطهي اللحوم والدجاج والخضراوات والأطعمة الأخرى لإعداد الأطباق المدرجة في قائمة الطعام. تحضير الشوربات وإعداد السلطات والمقبلات الباردة والساخنة. سلق وطهي الأطعمة الشرقية. تجهيز الأكلات بعد نضوجها ووضعها في الأواني المناسبة وتجهيزها للتقديم. الإشراف على تنظيف أدوات الطبخ والطعام، والمحافظة على إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الطهي. القدرة على استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وطهيها بكفاءة. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. بيئة العمل يعمل الطاهي ضمن فريق في بيئة مطبخ احترافية، ويساهم في إعداد وتقديم مجموعة متنوعة من الأطباق في الفنادق والمطاعم والنوادي. يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

85f04502c760953e.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel Motors is seeking a Warehouse Operation Supervisor to oversee warehouse operations in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves supervising receiving, binning, storage, picking, and dispatch processes to enhance productivity and ensure parts are handled correctly and efficiently, utilizing available resources according to company policies. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage the implementation of the Toyota Production System (TPS) in the main warehouse to ensure parts storage aligns with targeted levels and procedures, thereby improving business productivity. Ensure the correct handling of parts at the right time with the required quality, fully utilizing available warehouse resources at PIO Sub-warehouses as per company policies. Coordinate with various departments (Quality, Production, Planning, Inventory, and PD) regarding parts submission and documentation, including PIO order slips and parts discrepancy reports, to reconcile stock information. Oversee the daily implementation of 5S, PPO Audit, and IMTITHAL, and manage the updating and display of reports, including daily and monthly stock reports. Develop succession plans and training programs for team members. Prepare annual leave plans for reporting staff to prevent conflicts and ensure continuous daily operations. Manage knowledge transfer to staff and implement succession plans to improve staff satisfaction, productivity, and develop multi-skilled workers. Monitor sections, set new targets for each, and control operational costs in accordance with approved company policies and procedures. Operational Focus This role has a direct impact on monitoring warehouse operation activities and coordinating with other business units to implement best practices in warehouse operations. It also indirectly affects daily vehicle production related to parts. The supervisor is responsible for ensuring compliance with regulations and communicating updates to management and associates. Key Accountabilities and Performance Indicators Daily fulfillment of parts for production. Adherence to ISO9001 standards. Implementation of 5S methodology. Post-production Operation (PPO) management. Achieving daily targets for parts distribution without delay. Successful completion of bi-annual and monthly audits. Decision-Making Authority The Warehouse Operation Supervisor has the autonomy to develop succession plans and training programs, such as forklift safety training. The role involves medium supervision over daily operations and low authority over daily functional operations. Strategic Impact This position holds a crucial strategic role in the daily receiving of containers (GRN in JSAP system), warehouse storage management, and dispatching parts orders. It also provides crucial support to daily vehicle production.

85fc918c376eaccb.description: About Almarai Company Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and a leading food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is the number one FMCG Brand in MENA and a market leader across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across these regions, operating under the principle of “Quality you can trust.” Almarai’s product portfolio includes dairy products, juices and beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L’usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, Farm’s Select, Ice Leaf, Almira, Seama, Oska, IVAL, Almara Pro, Premier Chef, and Bakemart. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. The Opportunity Almarai is expanding its operations through aggressive growth programs and acquisitions in new vertical markets. This expansion has created an opportunity to join a multinational team dedicated to furthering the group's growth plans. This full-time position for a Senior Team Manager is based in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Purpose The Senior Team Manager is responsible for ensuring the consistent delivery of safe, compliant, and customer-approved products. This involves maintaining site quality systems, investigating and resolving complaints and non-conformances, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across hygiene, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and cold-chain operations. Key Responsibilities Oversee and maintain site quality systems to ensure product safety and compliance. Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances, implementing corrective actions. Drive continuous improvement in hygiene standards and practices. Ensure adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) across all operations. Manage and optimize cold-chain operations to maintain product integrity. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to manage quality systems and drive operational improvements. Compensation and Benefits Almarai offers a competitive remuneration package, which includes generous leave, medical coverage, and a discretionary bonus. The company also provides opportunities for training and development.

857301c2524a0d6a.description: About PIPECARE Group PIPECARE Group has over 25 years of experience providing technology and service-focused solutions to the international oil and gas industry, helping customers ensure the integrity of their pipeline and facility assets. The company specializes in In-Line Inspection (ILI) services to identify and size pipeline threats using advanced technologies such as Magnetic Flux Leakage, Transverse Field Inspection, Ultrasound, and specialized tools. The Role of Rigger Level 1 PIPECARE Group is seeking an experienced Rigger Level 1 to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for planning, supervising, and executing all rigging and lifting activities safely and efficiently. The Rigger Level 1 ensures that lifting operations comply with company procedures, client requirements, and applicable safety standards. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform and supervise all rigging and lifting activities according to approved lifting plans and safety procedures. Inspect all lifting equipment, including slings, shackles, hooks, chains, wire ropes, and spreader beams, before use. Ensure all lifting gear is properly certified, tagged, and fit for purpose. Determine load weights, center of gravity, and suitable lifting points prior to lifting operations. Coordinate with crane operators, supervisors, and lifting teams to ensure safe execution of lifting activities. Direct crane movements using approved hand signals and communication methods. Ensure loads are properly secured, balanced, and controlled during lifting operations. Conduct pre-lift inspections and participate in toolbox talks and risk assessments. Monitor lifting operations and stop any activity that presents a safety risk. Report damaged or defective lifting equipment and remove it from service. Maintain lifting equipment records and inspection logs. Assist in loading, unloading, positioning, and installation of equipment and materials. Guide and mentor junior riggers. Report incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions, and operational issues to the supervisor. Follow team leader instructions during all activities. Submit all lifting plans prior to each activity. Be available to meet client schedules and attend multiple activities in a single day. Train other employees as required by management. Notify the line manager for sick leave or annual vacation. Physical and Mental Requirements Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds. Must be able to walk and climb, including maneuvering within refinery or plant environments and accessing elevated platforms via ladders and stairwells. Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing, or other communication capabilities, to communicate effectively. Ability to maintain focus and multitask effectively. Must be able to wear safety equipment as required by the safety department for personal protection in manufacturing environments. Sufficient personal mobility and physical reflexes, with or without reasonable accommodations, to perform duties and travel to off-site locations when necessary. Company Commitment PIPECARE Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

859b0a7ad1b342a1.company_name: شركة الخدمات الطبية والصيدلانية لصاحبها بشيرشكيب الجابري وشركاه
859b0a7ad1b342a1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث جمعية الرحمة لغسيل الكلى عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على متابعة تركيب وتشغيل الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لضمان كفاءة الأداء وسلامة الاستخدام. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب الأجهزة الطبية، بما في ذلك أجهزة غسيل الكلى والأجهزة المساندة للقلب والتنفس والرئة وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب ومتابعة إجراءاته، وإعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي والتشغيل الفعلي للأجهزة الطبية وفقًا لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح. تتبع مخططات الدوائر الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بناءً على تعليمات الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية للأجهزة الطبية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة والطوارئ لضمان استمرارية عمل الأجهزة الطبية الحيوية. كيفية التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق جمعية الرحمة لغسيل الكلى، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم مع السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

85d66a0877b708cc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فطايرجي للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في شقراء، الرياض. يشغل هذا الدور مهندس مدني بدوام كامل مسؤول عن دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بإعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات الهندسية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع ومطابقة المواصفات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة شقراء بمنطقة الرياض. يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في فطايرجي للمقاولات، ويسهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة وفق أعلى معايير الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في فطايرجي للمقاولات.

850a5c72082b2271.description: About El Seif Engineering Contracting El Seif Engineering Contracting has a fifty-year history in the construction industry, focusing on meticulous planning and expert execution across diverse projects. The company emphasizes excellence, integrity, and innovation, aiming to deliver sustainable and impactful solutions in construction. Role Overview: SR. ENGINEER - PLANNING The Senior Engineer, Planning provides expert-level planning and scheduling services. This full-time role, based either at the company's HQ or on a project site, involves leading the development of competitive tender schedules or managing project baseline schedules. The position is responsible for monitoring progress, analyzing deviations, and conducting delay analyses for Extension of Time (EOT) claims. A minimum of 10 years of experience is required for this position. Key Responsibilities Lead the preparation of comprehensive, resource-loaded, and cost-loaded schedules, specifically Tender Schedules (HQ role) or Project Baseline Schedules (Project role), ensuring alignment with project scope and strategy. Develop and integrate logical work sequences and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) for all project disciplines. Monitor progress against the baseline, identify, analyze, and report schedule deviations, and recommend corrective actions or work-around solutions. Prepare and maintain Look-Ahead Schedules and Action Plans, leading weekly meetings to highlight delay risks and ensure accountability for mitigation actions. Implement standard delay analysis methodologies (*, Time Impact Analysis) to support the preparation of Extension of Time (EOT) claims (Project role). Review project documentation to identify and substantiate delay events (Project role) or to identify risks and assumptions for a bid (HQ role). Ensure all project controls data (WBS, CBS, budgets, schedules) is accurately set up and maintained in EPM/EPPM for tender proposals or active projects. Act as a key point of contact for schedule-related matters, liaising with tendering teams (HQ role) or project teams, clients, and consultants (Project role). Act as a subject matter expert (SME) by deploying on short-term assignments to project(s) providing targeted support during critical project phases or to help implement new procedures (HQ role). Provide technical guidance and mentorship to planning engineers and site teams (Project role) or to junior members of the tendering/planning team (HQ role) on scheduling best practices, project controls, and delay analysis. Act as a primary point of contact for schedule-related communications, ensuring alignment and clear understanding of project progress with clients and consultants (Project role) or tender schedule strategy with internal departments (HQ role). Contribute to the continuous improvement of planning processes, methodologies, and tools within the Project Planning Department, incorporating lessons learned from project execution or the tendering process. Benefits and Compensation This full-time position offers standard benefits including paid annual leave, public holidays, living allowances, healthcare coverage, and end of service benefits. Discretionary benefits such as a performance bonus, merit increase, and training and development opportunities may also be available based on eligibility. Salary details will be disclosed during the hiring process. Compliance Requirements Comply with corporate information security policies and procedures relevant to the role. Preserve the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Board and corporate information. Ensure access to sensitive information is restricted to authorized individuals. Protect organizational information assets from compromise. Comply with Data Protection and Intellectual Property Rights legislation applicable in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

859cb4ab1359c257.description: About the Role Hitachi Energy is seeking a Project Manager to lead the execution of medium-size to large and moderately complex GIS projects. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern region, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The Project Manager will ensure all project activities align with Hitachi Energy policies, contractual agreements, quality standards, health, safety, and environment requirements, financial targets, and schedule commitments. Key Responsibilities Execute projects according to contract scope, schedule, and contractual conditions. Review contracts from sales to understand terms and conditions, including awareness of risks related to margin, performance, and other factors. Proactively plan, monitor, and control project activities (scope, time, and cost), including project handover, execution planning, and monitoring of internal and external resources. Develop and finalize project schedules with relevant stakeholders (internal and external), prepare project-specific Master Document Lists, and maintain updates. Execute process activities in SAP and maintain documentation in accordance with ISO and internal process requirements throughout the project cycle. Coordinate with engineering and customers for timely approval of drawings and documents, and resolve project-related queries/issues during execution. Serve as the single point of contact and escalation point for customers regarding project issues, ensuring Hitachi Energy commitments are met as per contract. Improve customer satisfaction and feedback through consistent customer interaction, building trust, confidence, and loyalty. Prepare and submit project progress reports to customers as per contractual requirements. Closely monitor and document customer change requests related to project scope, obtaining approvals for time extensions and additional costs. Proactively evaluate and identify project risks, implement mitigating actions, and prepare project-specific risks and opportunities management plans. Coordinate with customers for Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), arrange timely dispatch clearances, and collaborate with commercial and logistics teams for invoicing and goods dispatch. Work with the service team for installation, testing, and commissioning at site, and with customers for timely payment collection, As-built drawings, collection of PAC & FAC, project closure, and handover to the service team. Report project status and progress to internal stakeholders and management with appropriate details. Adhere to the organization's project management processes. Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Uphold Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for personal actions while caring for colleagues and the business. Candidate Requirements 5-10 years of experience in project management. Strong leadership skills and the ability to influence stakeholders in the project's interest. Ability to deliver projects under pressure, meeting time, cost, and quality objectives. Experience working with customers in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern region. The role involves managing moderately complex GIS projects within a structured environment, ensuring compliance with established policies and standards.

85b6f25318700fa9.description: About the Role Group-IB is seeking an Integration Engineer, Fraud Protection, to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing to an innovative team focused on real-time fraud detection, prevention, and combat. The primary mission is to protect financial institutions and large organizations from digital fraud. Role Responsibilities The Integration Engineer will leverage technical acumen and analytical skills to design, implement, and maintain the company's anti-fraud solutions. Key responsibilities include: Designing, implementing, and maintaining integrations with anti-fraud solutions. Gathering and analyzing product requirements from stakeholders, including customers and internal teams. Preparing detailed implementation and integration documentation, such as API specifications and technical user stories. Collaborating closely with the technical team, tasking, and coordinating their efforts in solution implementation. Integrating solutions using APIs to ensure flexible and seamless processes. Conducting session and transaction analysis, utilizing tools like Kubernetes for troubleshooting and monitoring. Troubleshooting issues as a second line of support and delegating tasks to programmers when necessary. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. The role requires a strong technical background and an analytical mindset to effectively contribute to the development and deployment of anti-fraud technologies. About Group-IB Group-IB is a global cybersecurity company specializing in investigating, predicting, preventing, and combating digital crime. The company assists organizations in reducing risk and protecting trust. Group-IB's solutions are trusted by governments, major industries, and law enforcement agencies globally, including INTERPOL, Europol, and Afripol, across more than 60 countries. Employees work alongside industry leaders and contribute to technologies recognized by Gartner, Forrester, KuppingerCole, and Datos Insights. The team is international, with members from diverse backgrounds united by the mission to fight cybercrime.

85de2a3b8ff64fe8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة ومراقبة الأنظمة الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المتعلقة بأعمال تركيب الأنظمة الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. بيئة العمل سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بالربع الخالي. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في تركيب وصيانة المعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الإصلاحات اللازمة. مهارات التوجيه والتنسيق للفرق الفنية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

85f2120e30a8bc41.description: The Safety Specialist will support the Safety Lead in implementing and maintaining occupational health and safety programs across KAUST facilities, operations, maintenance activities, construction works, and projects . The role will focus on field inspections, audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, safety documentation, contractor engagement, training, corrective action tracking, and compliance with ISO 45001, HSE policies, and applicable regulatory requirements . The position requires a strong field-oriented HSE professional who can identify hazards, evaluate risks, provide practical safety guidance, investigate incidents, and work effectively with facility owners, project teams, contractors, and service providers. Key Responsibilities HSE Program Implementation: Support the Safety Lead in implementing and continuously improving risk-based safety programs across facilities, operations, maintenance, construction, and projects. Safety Inspections & Audits: Conduct risk-based site inspections, safety audits, compliance evaluations, and field verifications to ensure HSE requirements are being followed. Risk Assessment: Perform hazard identification and risk assessments and verify that appropriate control measures are implemented and effective. Safety Documentation Review: Review HSE documents including risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, permits-to-work, lifting plans, excavation plans, confined-space controls, electrical work procedures, and MOC documentation. Incident Investigation: Investigate or support investigations of accidents, injuries, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Corrective Action Tracking: Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from inspections, audits, investigations, and observations, ensuring timely closure and escalation of overdue actions. HSE Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, workshops, permit-to-work training, and awareness programs to improve employee and contractor competency. Stakeholder & Contractor Support: Provide practical HSE guidance to facility owners, project teams, contractors, service providers, and other stakeholders to support safe execution of activities. HSE Reporting & Data Analysis: Collect and analyze HSE data, KPIs, inspection findings, audit results, incident trends, and corrective action status, providing reports and recommendations to management. Safety Culture & Compliance: Promote a strong safety culture, intervene in unsafe activities, communicate lessons learned, maintain accurate HSE records, and support compliance with ISO 45001, regulations, policies, procedures, and industry best practices. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related safety discipline is required. Professional Certification: ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification is required. Incident Investigation: Certification or formal training in Incident Root Cause Analysis is required. HSE Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in occupational safety, facilities safety, construction safety, contractor management, projects, auditing, compliance, or related HSE functions. Risk Management: Strong experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, risk control, and implementation of risk-based safety programs. High-Risk Activities: Practical knowledge of safety controls for work at height, lifting operations, excavation, confined spaces, hot work, electrical work, and permit-to-work systems. ISO & Audit Knowledge: Working knowledge of ISO 45001, safety management systems, auditing, inspections, incident investigation, and corrective action management. Knowledge of ISO 19011 and ISO 31000 is an advantage. Safety Certifications: Additional recognized HSE qualifications such as CSP, CHST, NEBOSH Certificate/Diploma, IOSH, or equivalent are preferred. Train-the-Trainer certification is also an advantage. Communication & Reporting: Excellent English communication skills with the ability to prepare professional HSE reports, inspection records, investigation reports, presentations, and safety documentation.
